lines.text: 'Tis the next way to turn tailor, or be redbreast-teacher. An the indentures be drawn, I'll away within these two hours; and so come in when ye will.
lines.plainText: 'Tis the next way to turn tailor or be redbreastteacher An the indentures be drawn I'll away within these two hours and so come in when ye will

lines.text: Come, come, Lord Mortimer, you are as slow
lines.plainText: Come come Lord Mortimer you are as slow

lines.text: As hot Lord Percy is on fire to go.
lines.plainText: As hot Lord Percy is on fire to go

lines.text: By this our book is drawn. We'll but seal,
lines.plainText: By this our book is drawn We'll but seal

lines.text: And then to horse immediately.
lines.plainText: And then to horse immediately

lines.text: With all my heart.
lines.plainText: With all my heart
